content.short: DEXGuru is a trading platform with decentralized exchange token insights and analytics in one interface.
content.description: DEXGuru is a decentralized token swap platform designed for DeFi traders. It combines real-time market data, actionable insights, and smooth token swapping into a single service, helping users trade confidently while staying up to date with prices. Price updates and trading signals are accessible via a Discord bot, and developers can use the DexGuru API to build custom data services and tooling tailored to their own applications.
